display.purpose: Game page title on the hero.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked section labels and kickers.

shadows.name: cover-lift
shadows.purpose: Hovered or focused cover with white outline.

motion.name: ambient-fade
motion.purpose: Ambient tint fading in when the last-played art loads.

components.name: Primary Pill
components.description: The one primary action: Play, Install, Log in.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: #0e0e14; font: 700 14px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms, transform 120ms; } .ds-pill:hover { background: #e4e6ee; } .ds-pill:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Glass filter chip; selected state is brighter glass.
components.css: .ds-chip { height: 36px; min-width: 36px; padding: 0 12px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 10px; background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.32); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.75); font: 14px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.09); color: #eef0f6; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.16); border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22); color: #eef0f6; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Glass search box in the top bar.
components.css: .ds-search { height: 36px; width: 280px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 10px; background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.32); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22); background: rgb(10 10 16 / 0.6); } .ds-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #eef0f6; font: 14px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5); }

components.name: Cover Card (not installed)
components.description: 2:3 cover with faded art, store logo top-right and Install chip bottom-left.
components.css: .ds-cover { position: relative; width: 180px; height: 270px; border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1f1f2a, #16161f); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); transition: transform 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms ease-out; } .ds-cover:hover { transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.03); box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6), 0 0 0 2px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85); } .ds-name { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 16px; font: 600 15px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; text-align: center; color: #8d90a3; } .ds-logo { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgb(10 10 16 / 0.62); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); } .ds-install { position: absolute; left: 8px; bottom: 8px; padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(10 10 16 / 0.68); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); color: #fff; font: 600 11px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; }

components.name: Notice
components.description: Dismissible one-line glass banner under the toolbar.
components.html: You were logged out of Epic Games. Log in again in Settings.
components.css: .ds-notice { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 16px; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgb(10 10 16 / 0.6); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); color: #eef0f6; font: 14px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-notice span { flex: 1; } .ds-notice button { padding: 6px 14px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22); border-radius: 8px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.16); color: inherit; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Settings switch; accent violet when on.
components.css: .ds-toggle { position: relative; width: 40px; height: 22px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #7c5cff; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms; } .ds-toggle::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; transition: transform 120ms; transform: translateX(18px); } .ds-toggle[aria-checked='false'] { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18); } .ds-toggle[aria-checked='false']::after { transform: none; } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Working name 'Ambient' (owner): the last-played game's art, heavily blurred and saturated, tints the window and fades to near-black; chrome is translucent dark glass with thin light borders; the primary action is a solid white pill. Dark-only, dense, content-first desktop app.
keyCharacteristics: One ambient tint layer behind everything, static while scrolling.
Dark glass chrome with thin light borders.
Solid white pill is the only primary action.
Store identity and installed state readable on every cover.
Quiet by default: no status text or spinners on every start.

rules.name: The One Bright Thing Rule
rules.body: The solid white pill is the only solid-bright element on a screen.

rules.name: The Tint Comes From The Art Rule
rules.body: Chromatic colour on the library comes from the ambient layer. UI chrome stays neutral.

rules.name: The No Halo Rule
rules.body: Shadows are black and directional. No coloured glow halos.

rules.name: The Static Backdrop Rule
rules.body: Blur is applied once off-screen or only on small non-scrolling surfaces.

dos: Do use the CSS custom properties in src/app.css; add a token before adding a raw value.
Do keep scrolling at the benchmark level: LAUNCHER_BENCH 175 fps, 0 dropped frames over 613 games at 4,000 and 15,000 px/s.
Do reserve space for late data so nothing jumps.
Do hide a missing fact's tile or row instead of showing a dash.
Do show store logos from the bundled Simple Icons SVGs, white, never fetched at runtime.
donts: Don't use gradient text, coloured glow halos, or neon for its own sake.
Don't flash status text or spinners on every start.
Don't put a live blur or backdrop-filter on scrolling content.
Don't show a second solid-bright button next to the white pill.
Don't add UI libraries or packages without the owner's approval.
